privacy.title: Privacy Policy | InoRobot Assistant
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: INOVANCE Robot Assistant (the “Site”) values visitors’ privacy. This policy explains what information the Site processes and why.
privacy.notice: The Site does not provide account registration, login, payment, or inquiry forms. It does not directly collect or store information such as visitors’ names, telephone numbers, or email addresses.
privacy.operatorContact: The email address above is the official contact for privacy and Site operation inquiries. If the contact route changes, the latest information will be posted on this page.
privacy.analyticsParagraph1: Cloudflare Web Analytics is used to understand Site usage and performance. Analytics may include visited page paths, referring pages, visit times, browser, operating-system and device types, country-level location information, and page performance information.
privacy.analyticsParagraph2: Analytics is configured not to use cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB. Cloudflare states that it discards IP addresses received during analytics beacon processing at a nearby data center and does not store them in its core databases or logs.
privacy.visitorCountParagraph: Cloudflare Workers and KV storage are used to maintain the existing aggregate visitor count shown on the home page. During visitor-request processing, the Worker combines the IP address, browser information (User-Agent), and language information, then converts the value into a one-way hash to check duplicate visits for five minutes. The original IP address and browser information are not stored, and the duplicate-check hash key expires automatically after five minutes. Only the numeric total is stored for the aggregate visitor count.
privacy.externalHeading: c. External resources and file downloads
privacy.externalParagraph: External services such as Google Fonts, cdnjs, unpkg, esm.sh, GitHub, and Cloudflare Workers may be used to provide the Site’s interface, features, and files. When the browser requests those resources, ordinary connection information such as the IP address, browser information, and request URL may be sent to the relevant service. That service’s privacy policy and terms of use apply.
privacy.purpose1: Improve the Site by reviewing page usage and visitor trends
privacy.purpose2: Display the existing aggregate visitor count and review visitor trends
privacy.purpose3: Understand page-loading performance and error causes
privacy.purpose4: Provide file downloads and Site features reliably
privacy.purpose5: Prevent malicious requests, automated attacks, and abuse of the service
privacy.retentionParagraph: The Site operator does not directly collect or retain member data or original IP addresses. The aggregate visitor count is retained as a numeric total, and the duplicate-check hash key expires automatically after five minutes. Cloudflare Web Analytics data is processed according to Cloudflare’s service policies and retention settings. The Site operator uses analytics results only to improve the Site.
privacy.sharingParagraph: The Site does not sell visitor information or provide it as a personal-information list for advertising purposes. However, Cloudflare, GitHub, and external CDNs may provide analytics, hosting, content delivery, and file services to the extent necessary.
privacy.rightsParagraph: Questions about personal-information processing and requests for access, correction, deletion, or restriction of processing may be sent to jeongchan.lee@inovance.com. If the Site does not collect directly identifiable personal information, the information available to process such a request may be limited.
privacy.changesParagraph: This page may be updated when analytics tools, external services, or applicable laws change. The effective date will be updated and the change will be published.
